conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and underperforming assets. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leveraging strong setups and existing winners.
